scope: Pure Code/Tape codec and owner-independent code identity only; no signing, transactions, HTTP, nodes or public capability claim.

tbcLibJsTree.algorithm: sha256(sorted relative-path + NUL + file-sha256 + LF); excludes node_modules and .git

provenance.execution: Pinned upstream TypeScript transpiled in memory to CommonJS/ES2020; no source edits or runtime identity reimplementation.
provenance.identityMeaning: Upstream partial-SHA256 code identity plus ScriptNum size, stable across controller replacement; not a raw full-script hash, network-qualified asset ID or ownership proof.
provenance.metadataMeaning: Display declaration only; this fixture does not imply consensus enforcement of metadata or declared supply.
